# Environment of the API. Export these variables (or set them in your IDE) before running it. Never commit real values.

# Port the API listens on
PORT=8080

# Database connection
DATABASE_URL=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/api
DATABASE_USER=api
DATABASE_PASSWORD=change-me

# Secret that signs the tokens of your identity provider (at least 32 bytes). Without it every protected request is rejected.
JWT_SECRET=
# Optional: expected audience and issuer of the tokens
JWT_AUDIENCE=
JWT_ISSUER=

files.README.md:
# library-api

REST API generated by [Model2API](https://raulesteveza.github.io/tools/Model2API/) with Spring Boot. It is a starting point: review it before using it in production.

## Run it

Requires Java 21 and Maven 3.9 or later.

```bash
mvn spring-boot:run
```

Set the variables of `.env.example` in your environment first. The API listens on http://localhost:8080; the interactive documentation is at http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html, and the contract in `openapi.yaml`.

## Test it

```bash
mvn test
```

The tests use an in-memory H2 database, or the one in `TEST_DATABASE_URL` (with `TEST_DATABASE_USER` and `TEST_DATABASE_PASSWORD`).

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | What it does | Success | Access |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/authors` | List authors | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/authors/{id}` | Get an author | 200 | authenticated |
| `POST` | `/authors` | Create an author | 201 | authenticated |
| `PUT` | `/authors/{id}` | Replace an author | 200 | authenticated |
| `PATCH` | `/authors/{id}` | Update part of an author | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/authors/{id}` | Delete an author | 204 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/books` | List books | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/books/{id}` | Get a book | 200 | authenticated |
| `POST` | `/books` | Create a book | 201 | authenticated |
| `PUT` | `/books/{id}` | Replace a book | 200 | authenticated |
| `PATCH` | `/books/{id}` | Update part of a book | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/books/{id}` | Delete a book | 204 | authenticated |

Errors always have the same body: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": [...]}}`. Invalid requests answer 400.

## Storage

JPA with Hibernate on postgresql. Hibernate creates missing tables while you develop (`spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=update`); for a real database, use migrations (Model2DB writes them). Embedded objects and lists are stored as JSON columns, and references as key columns.

## Authentication

Protected endpoints need a bearer token issued by your identity provider, signed with HS256. The API verifies it with `JWT_SECRET` (and `JWT_AUDIENCE` / `JWT_ISSUER` when set), requires an expiry, and reads the roles from the `roles` claim. It does not issue tokens.

## Structure

```text
src/main/java/com/example/api/
  common/               errors, lists and request bodies
  model/                domain classes, enums and embedded objects
  dto/                  request bodies and responses
  repository/           storage
  service/              rules of each resource
  controller/           HTTP routes
src/test/java/          one test class per resource
openapi.yaml            the contract of the API
```

## Left to you

- Nothing marked: review the generated code before using it.

# Settings of the tests: they replace src/main/resources/application.properties while the tests run
spring.application.name=library-api

# Unknown fields in a request body are an error, as openapi.yaml describes
spring.jackson.deserialization.fail-on-unknown-properties=true

# Secret, audience and issuer of the tokens (environment variables JWT_SECRET, JWT_AUDIENCE, JWT_ISSUER)
app.jwt.secret=test-secret-with-at-least-32-bytes!
app.jwt.audience=
app.jwt.issuer=

# An in-memory H2 database, or the database in TEST_DATABASE_URL
spring.datasource.url=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:jdbc:h2:mem:test;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1}
spring.datasource.username=${TEST_DATABASE_USER:sa}
spring.datasource.password=${TEST_DATABASE_PASSWORD:}
spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=create-drop
spring.jpa.open-in-view=false
spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.timezone.default_storage=NORMALIZE_UTC
# Column names that are reserved words in some database (MySQL: "lines", "order"…) are quoted
spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.auto_quote_keyword=true
